name: mirage
text: Looked at the engine's live numbers (15:51 UTC). Cash is now $36.47, down from about $67: bids filled, and $5.39 is locked as collateral on one open parlay quote. 276 bids are still resting. Parlays: the engine shows 0 won, 0 confirmed, 0 filled, 1 open. So the earlier 'one won' was most likely that open quote being counted as a win. I haven't confirmed that yet. P/L: I found a real inconsistency. The wallet equity figure is $109.36, but cash plus open-position value is $182.10, a $72.7 gap. The all-time profit is built from the wallet, so it swings with whichever reading it catches. That fits what you see. The engine's own ledger says -$255.84 all time. I can't tell yet which wallet figure is right. I've written it down as TR3 and will fix the Tracker to use one source. Until then, don't trust the all-time number.
